title: Companion-persuasion checks ('try to settle the X') at climactic story beats used my worst attribute-adjacent DC (will+3, ~40-55% odds) with no warning that failure would anger BOTH companions at once; felt like a trap option relative to the safer 'back one side' choices.
where: companion dispute dialogs (e.g. The Waking Glade, Barrowmere)
